name: @dsh-toolset/script-interpreter
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 进程内集成插件：模型侧脚本解释器（script_run，自动探测并切换 python / node / sh 解释器）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-script-interpreter && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-script-interpreter && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-script-interpreter node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-script-interpreter tmp/cov-script-interpreter/report.json
